metadata.case_name: LUO XIAO RONG v. FULL TREND DEVELOPMENT LIMITED T/A BANQUET DELICIOUS

plaintiff.occupation_before: part-time pantry helper/food conveyor employed by the defendant

injuries.description: contusion of the low back [with no other complications such as fracture, dislocation or other neurological deficits]
source: In the joint medical report of the two doctors, Dr Chun states that the appropriate diagnosis should be one of “contusion of the low back [with no other complications such as fracture, dislocation or other neurological deficits]”.
injuries.icd_description: Contusion of lower back or pelvis

manifestations.description: severe soft tissue injury to the back (as noted by Dr Mui)

treatments_received.treatment: Conservative treatment and discharge from A&E
source: After the accident, the plaintiff was admitted to the A&E of Tuen Mun Hospital. Medical examination revealed that there was tenderness over the lumbar region. Hospitalisation was not considered necessary and the plaintiff was conservatively treated and discharged.

Physiotherapy and occupational therapy were prescribed. After several sessions of therapy, on 15 June 2012, the plaintiff reported in a self-assessment that the level of pain had reduced from 8, out of a scale of 1 to 10, to 2.

treatments_received.treatment: Outpatient follow-up and subsequent clinic visits
source: The plaintiff attended the A&E of Tuen Mun Hospital on 6 March 2012 and 10 March 2012 for back pain.
There were more visits to the Tuen Mun Hospital and Department of Family Medicine & Primary Health Care of Tuen Mun Wu Hong Clinic in the subsequent months.

losses.description: Pain and suffering and loss of amenity resulting from contusion of the low back
